title: Smart Data Models - SunSpec Information Models - DERMeasureDC
description: DER DC Measurement. DER DC measurement. SunSpec Information Model 714 (DERMeasureDC), sunspec/models v2026-04-20. Point names kept verbatim; values are given already scaled, so the scale-factor (*_SF), padding and model framing (ID, L) points are left out.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:DERMeasureDC:<Mn>-<SN> (manufacturer and serial number of the device).

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DERMeasureDC'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

refCommon.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. The `common` entity (SunSpec model 1: manufacturer, model, serial number) of the device that exposes this SunSpec model. Not a SunSpec point (Smart Data Models addition): in SunSpec all models of a device are read from the same Modbus map, whose first model is always model 1.

dateObserved.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the values of this SunSpec model were read from the device. Not a SunSpec point (Smart Data Models addition): SunSpec models carry no timestamp.

PrtAlrms.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_714.json#PrtAlrms'. Port Alarms. Bitfield of ports with active alarms. Bit is 1 if port has an active alarm. Bit 0 is first port. Bitfield without SunSpec symbols: the raw integer value of the bitfield. SunSpec type bitfield32.

NPrt.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_714.json#NPrt'. Number Of Ports. Number of DC ports. SunSpec type uint16. Static value (does not change during operation).

DCA.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_714.json#DCA'. DC Current. Total DC current for all ports. Units:'A'. SunSpec type int16 with scale factor DCA_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCA_SF).

DCW.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_714.json#DCW'. DC Power. Total DC power for all ports. Units:'W'. SunSpec type int16 with scale factor DCW_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCW_SF).

DCWhInj.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_714.json#DCWhInj'. DC Energy Injected. Total cumulative DC energy injected for all ports. Units:'Wh'. SunSpec type uint64 with scale factor DCWH_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCWH_SF).

DCWhAbs.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_714.json#DCWhAbs'. DC Energy Absorbed. Total cumulative DC energy absorbed for all ports. Units:'Wh'. SunSpec type uint64 with scale factor DCWH_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCWH_SF).

PrtTyp.description: Port Type. Values are the SunSpec symbol names (PV=0, ESS=1, EV=2, INJ=3, ABS=4, BIDIR=5, DC_DC=6). SunSpec type enum16.

IDStr.description: Port ID String. SunSpec type string.

DCA.description: DC Current. DC current for the port. Units:'A'. SunSpec type int16 with scale factor DCA_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCA_SF).

DCV.description: DC Voltage. DC voltage for the port. Units:'V'. SunSpec type uint16 with scale factor DCV_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCV_SF).

DCW.description: DC Power. DC power for the port. Units:'W'. SunSpec type int16 with scale factor DCW_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCW_SF).

DCWhInj.description: DC Energy Injected. Total cumulative DC energy injected for the port. Units:'Wh'. SunSpec type uint64 with scale factor DCWH_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCWH_SF).

DCWhAbs.description: DC Energy Absorbed. Total cumulative DC energy absorbed for the port. Units:'Wh'. SunSpec type uint64 with scale factor DCWH_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^DCWH_SF).

Tmp.description: DC Port Temperature. Units:'C'. SunSpec type int16 with scale factor Tmp_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^Tmp_SF).

DCSta.description: DC Port Status. Values are the SunSpec symbol names (OFF=0, ON=1, WARNING=2, ERROR=3). SunSpec type enum16.

DCAlrm.description: DC Port Alarm. Bitfield: the array lists the names of the bits that are set (GROUND_FAULT=bit 0, INPUT_OVER_VOLTAGE=bit 1, DC_DISCONNECT=bit 3, CABINET_OPEN=bit 5, MANUAL_SHUTDOWN=bit 6, OVER_TEMP=bit 7, BLOWN_FUSE=bit 12, UNDER_TEMP=bit 13, MEMORY_LOSS=bit 14, ARC_DETECTION=bit 15, RESERVED=bit 19, TEST_FAILED=bit 20, INPUT_UNDER_VOLTAGE=bit 21, INPUT_OVER_CURRENT=bit 22); an empty array means no bit set. SunSpec type bitfield32.

Prt.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_714.json#Prt'. Prt. SunSpec repeating group (count: NPrt); each array item is one repetition, with the same point names as in SunSpec; values are given already scaled.
